definition: Stable identifier for publication, dataset, or requested study package.
Stable sampling site identifier within a study.
Site longitude in WGS84 decimal degrees.
Site latitude in WGS84 decimal degrees.
Spatial uncertainty in meters or equivalent documented precision.
Sampling date or interval start/end; at least month/year preferred.
Authority or reference used for host taxonomy harmonization.
Trap effort denominator for captures at site/time/species or study stratum.
Number of captured individuals for the stratum.
Number of individuals tested for hantavirus infection or antibodies.
Number of tested individuals positive by the stated assay.
Diagnostic assay type and target, e.g. PCR, ELISA, IFA, antigen/antibody.
Short protocol or citation describing trap design and testing workflow.
Reuse license, data-sharing terms, or author-granted permission scope.
